title: Meta employees test prediction-market app, WSJ reports
html:
Meta logo in this illustration taken November 6, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Nov 13 : Meta Platforms' employees have begun testing a prediction-market app called Takes, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

Here are some details:

• Employees can wager on the outcome of questions or events using "cred," short for credibility, rather than real money, the report said

• The app is not available to the public and it is unclear when, if ever, it will be released, according to the report

• Meta did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment

• Prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket are drawing Gen Z users, with just over 60 per cent of their users under the age of 35 years, according to a recent S&P Global Market Intelligence Kagan survey
summary: Workers wager virtual 'cred' points, not cash, the WSJ reports.
